sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 1000. Success value 100. 5x physical damage (Fire).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 1000. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Fire).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Activates Time Slice which reduces the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to the target by 100 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Chipped Blade (nullifies effects that penetrate damage reduction or reflection when using an attack Ability) for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Erosion (nullifies effects that penetrate nullifying or invulnerability effects when using an attack Ability) for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Diffusion. The next Ability used will change from a specified single/range target to targeting all (except for certain Abilities).
-Target: all allies. Applies Twilight for 150 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; heals for 10% of damage dealt; boosts Break increase value by 40; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; fills Unison gauge by 20; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
-Target: all allies. Applies Dawn for 150 seconds (increases max HP and all stats by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; recovers 10 Cost when using an Ability. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; applies Dual Attack; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
-Target: yourself. Applies Ambush for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; reduces the cooldown time of Abilities to 0 (except for certain Abilities); nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Nebulous Eclipse (nullifies constant effect skills, applies Grief (10% chance to increase damage received by 50%), increases Ability Power of damage taken while in Break by 50, and increases Ability Power of damage taken from critical hits by 50) to the enemy Field for 90 seconds.
Boosts stats of Monsters of all elements by 60% when equipped in the Main Slot.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 40000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all enemies. Applies debuff removal resistance that blocks debuff removal, special debuff removal, or kismet 1 time.
Fire and Water Defense from Unison Damage +700
